GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (5 Dec 46) LS-R
(SCAPIN-1381)
APO 500
5 December 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Clarification of Status of Former Suspected War Criminal.
The following named Japanese listed on Memorandum indicated below is deleted from said list, is released from suspicion as Suspected War Criminal, is released from Sugamo Prison, and henceforth will be returned to his former status.
NAME MEMORANDUM 14 Jun 46 PAGE NO.
NOGUCHI, Terumitsu Sgt/Maj 1
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
